primary_objective: Code quality and fewer implementation errors caused by missing context
secondary_objective: Reduce end-to-end token use at equivalent or better quality
recommendation: Do not integrate experimental v2. Prioritize verifiable inventory, literal normative contracts, typed impact selection and controlled expansion; evaluate end-to-end quality before savings.
claim_boundary: Structural simulations, local fixture probes and bounded model code-generation experiments are not a production certification or a representative end-to-end coding benchmark.
